summary: Risk sentiment is defensive today: hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation is pressuring rates-sensitive technology and crypto assets, while a Treasury rebound is weakening the dollar and lifting gold.[1][4] Bitcoin and Ether are under selling pressure, but some analysts expect the broader altcoin correction to be temporary and identify selective opportunities in XRP and smaller altcoins.[1][2][8]
